definitions: A rental cost that is excessively high or unreasonable, often far exceeding the fair market value or what is considered affordable.
An unjustifiably inflated amount charged for the use of property, typically a residence or commercial space.
examples: Many residents are struggling due to the exorbitant rental price.
The city council debated solutions to combat the exorbitant rental price.
They decided against moving to the area because of the exorbitant rental price.
